title: Resistance to shear (steel framing).
officialText: Cold-formed steel framed shear walls sheathed with gypsum board and constructed in accordance with the materials and provisions of Section 2210.6 of this code are permitted to resist wind and seismic loads. Walls resisting seismic loads shall be subject to the limitations in Section 12.2.1 of ASCE 7.
